subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicitly configured custom-basename bootstrap files as a core `bootstrap-extra-files` contract, or keep extra bootstrap loading limited to recognized workspace filenames?
rationale: Current behavior is clear in source and release, but expanding startup context injection changes a config-driven prompt surface and needs maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Approve Bounded Custom Files
options.body: Allow custom-basename files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or replacement is rebased and preserves path guards, budgets, docs, and session filtering.

options.title: Keep Recognized Basenames
options.body: Reject arbitrary workspace-file injection and keep bootstrap extras limited to the existing first-class workspace filenames.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context API
options.body: Keep this issue open or supersede it with a larger context API design if raw configured files are not the desired permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Custom Files
recommendation.body: Allow custom-basename files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or replacement is rebased and preserves path guards, budgets, docs, and session filtering.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has recent adjacent bootstrap boundary work and the strongest available product-decision routing signal from the issue timeline.
